5c59c1e20cdb.title: Potential Logic Flaw
5c59c1e20cdb.reason: An active run with no activity for 10+ minutes is shown as stalled on purpose: that is the point of the stale detection Kees asked for. Within 30 s it is live, before 10 min quiet; tests-node/liveness.test.mts covers each case.

ab53fe6cd88a.title: SQL Injection Risk
ab53fe6cd88a.reason: COLUMNS is a compile-time constant with no user input; values go through bound parameters. last_activity is the max over finished/started runs, calls and PC actions of running runs, NULL when none; covered by the a_task_says_whether_a_run_is_active test.

ede24bcd37eb.title: Missing Error Handling
ede24bcd37eb.reason: stepLine starts with const tool = a.tool ?? {}, so a missing tool renders an empty line; every field read after it has a ?? or typeof fallback.
